headline: Data Analyst
summary: Detail-oriented professional with a strong foundation in data visualization and business intelligence, eager to leverage analytical skills to drive data-informed decision-making in Nepal's evolving fintech sector.

experiences.title: Junior Data Analyst
description: Developed automated dashboards using Power BI to track daily branch performance, increasing reporting efficiency by 30%.
Cleaned and processed large datasets from core banking systems to support quarterly risk assessments.
Collaborated with the IT team to integrate customer feedback data into the centralized reporting portal.

experiences.title: Data Intern
description: Assisted in the design of SQL queries for internal project tracking systems.
Created interactive visualization reports for stakeholders using Python libraries such as Matplotlib and Seaborn.
Conducted data validation audits to ensure the integrity of client-facing analytics reports.
